newsitem.title: FRANCE: French drugs firm to announce major deal Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: French drugs firm to announce major deal Wednesday.

text.p: A French pharmaceuticals company and another firm will announce details on Wednesday of a transaction which will be the biggest of its kind on the Paris stock market, an executive at the Publicis public relations agency said on Tuesday.
She declined to name the companies involved. The details would be announced at a news conference at 9 a.m. (0800 GMT).
The pharmaceuticals/chemicals sector has attracted merger speculation for months, particularly about Rhone-Poulenc, which is seen by analysts as being ripe for a break up.
A Rhone spokeswoman declined comment, saying: "I have no information on this."
Rhone American Depositary Receipts were up in New York, while Rhone shares in Paris ended trading 1.90 percent higher at 166.8 francs.
Officials of drugs groups Synthelabo, Sanofi, Roussel-Uclaf and L'Oreal were not immediately available for comment.
